hero.headline: A small team that ships large systems.
hero.subdescription: Orvexiq Lab is a product studio, not a staffing agency. We take a handful of clients at a time and embed deeply enough to be genuinely useful.

paragraphs: Not because nobody could design a good screen. Because the fiftieth screen was designed by someone who never saw the first ten, using values nobody wrote down.
We build the layer underneath — the tokens, the components, the decisions — so that the fiftieth screen costs a fraction of what the first one did and still looks like it belongs.
That is unglamorous work. It is also the difference between a product that stays coherent for years and one that needs a redesign every eighteen months.

principles.subdescription: They decide what we take on, how we run it, and what we leave behind.

items.title: Systems over screens
items.body: A screen solves today. A system solves the next fifty — and keeps them consistent without anyone policing it.

items.title: Embedded, not external
items.body: We sit with your engineers through build. Design that is thrown over a wall arrives as something else.

items.title: Proof over opinion
items.body: Research and measurement settle arguments. The loudest person in the room is not a methodology.

items.title: Fewer clients, deeper work
items.body: We take a handful at a time. Capacity is a design constraint like any other.

ctaSection.subdescriptionLine1: Tell us the problem. We will come back with how we would approach it —
